annotations.title: AI job description writer + bias audit

description: AI job description writer + bias audit — Write an inclusive job description from title= (optional company=, location=, remote=, salary=, level=, notes=, tone=) and get Markdown plus an offline audit; or pass text= to audit an existing posting without AI. The audit flags gender-coded words (Gaucher, Friesen and Kay word lists), age-coded and native-speaker phrases, jargon like rockstar or ninja, long experience minimums, missing pay range where a US pay-transparency posting law applies (CA, CO, WA, NY, IL, MN, MA, NJ, MD, VT, HI, DC and more), missing EEO statement; returns score 0-100 and grade. Example: /v1/ai/job-description?title=Senior Data Engineer&location=Denver, CO&salary=$140k-$170k Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: ai_job_description
